profile.summary: Sagardeep Alloys Limited manufactures and sells copper metal items in India. The company offers copper pipes and tubes, flats, coils, rods, anodes, nuggets, and plates, as well as oxygen free copper; red, yellow, cartridge, and low brass; gilding metals, commercial bronzes, and muntz metals; cupro nickel tubes, pipes, and rods; and stainless-steel scrap grades, pipes, tubes, sheets/plates, coils,
